name: mda
description: MDA Open Spec — a Markdown superset for agent-facing documents. One .mda source compiles to drop-in SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, MCP-SERVER.md, and CLAUDE.md. JSON Schema validated, with typed dependency graph, footnote relationships, and Sigstore-anchored signatures. For agentskills.io and AAIF runtimes.
